page_title: AI Coding Tool Releases and Changelogs, Tracked Daily | Havoptic

sources.entry: Havoptic - Free, open-source release tracker for AI coding tools. Aggregates changelogs from Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and more.

summary.name: Havoptic
summary.one_liner: Havoptic is a daily-updated release tracker that aggregates and plain-English summarizes version changelogs from AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI.
keywords: what's new in ai coding tools
use_cases: Keeping up with new releases of AI coding agents
Comparing features across AI coding tools
Checking version history of Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex CLI
Finding which AI coding tool recently added a feature
summary.what_it_does: The page is a timeline of recent releases from about 20 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Kiro CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Devin Desktop, Cline, OpenCode, Zed, and Replit Agent. Each entry lists the tool, version, date, and a short summary of what changed. The page says updates are automated and run daily, with the last update shown as October 29, 2026. It also links to popular side-by-side comparisons (such as Claude Code vs Cursor) and to a blog with weekly digests and monthly comparisons.
notable: Tracks about 20 AI coding tools in one daily-updated timeline
Automated pipelines produce plain-English summaries of each changelog
Includes side-by-side comparison pages and a blog with weekly digests
caveats: Relies on automated pipelines, so summaries may not match the original release notes exactly
Covers only the tools listed on the page; other AI coding tools are not included
